# GDEP014TT1 waveform / 波形来源

`WaveformData.c` is an unmodified copy of the E Ink SW-TCON example supplied with the tested display. Its SHA256 is `65207e33833b14652bfbd25e91fd2121cf35b36f63df29a2a23e99d90dc9e78f`. The extracted 74472-byte table has SHA256 `48b099be4e104e55052baafb70fac10f2c2fa225e83bd2f67ec18452fa5b7a86`.
